messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands in profile, then raises both arms to adjust the vest and shirt around the chest before lowering the arms and returning to a standing pose.","camera":"Static medium shot at roughly waist-to-head height, framing the subject from the side against the background.","clothing":"A pink-and-blue plaid button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, a brown vest with straps, and dark trousers.","hair_color":"Light lavender or pale purple.","hairstyle":"Short hair with a small top-knot bun at the crown of the head.","identity":"A young person with a slim build and light skin, shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"A wet, reflective plaza in front of a large dark building with a glowing circular neon ring and pink-lit window frames, with city buildings visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced with the reference wet plaza, dark building, glowing circular neon ring, and pink-lit windows. The person now receives strong pink/red neon lighting on the face, arms, and shirt, matching the new environment. The person's pose, clothing, hair, and action sequence remain broadly consistent, and the camera remains a static side medium shot.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the old street scene with the reference cyberpunk plaza environment and apply its lighting to the person, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was preserved exactly, since the face is strongly tinted and partly obscured in some frames.
unexpected_changes: The person's skin and shirt are heavily tinted pink/red by the new lighting, making the original appearance less neutral than in the source.
